title: ACTUAL-FLOW V4 — Repository-bound Coordinated Engineering
intent: Ship scoped, high-leverage changes using explicit approval boundaries and current source-backed proof.
reasoningSequence: Red Team 1: challenge premise, source and scope
LindyMode: preserve reliable, reversible existing carriers
L99: bind provenance, authority, recovery and temporal drift
Implement only what current scoped approval allows

codexRouting.devWorkflows: Plan features, investigate bugs, orchestrate bounded independent work and review release readiness
codexRouting.coordinator: Only for explicit goal-scoped parallel durable work in one shared repository checkout
codexRouting.engineeringGuardrails: Implement narrowly, then independently verify against acceptance criteria
codexRouting.processJobs: Finite, potentially long local workloads with a concrete command and working directory
codexRouting.testFlightRelease: macOS/Xcode iOS beta build and upload after distinct user authorization
codexRouting.materialThemes: Codex editor appearance only; no product UI mutations

authorityBoundary: This workflow and its fingerprints and proof cookies are evidence only. No private-resource access, deletion, data sharing, auth/RLS changes, merges, pushes, deployments, publication, spending, TestFlight release, or other consequential execution without appropriate task-specific authority. Founder Control Room and each repository retain their stricter gates.
stopCondition: Stop when the authorized outcome is verified or an explicit approval/evidence blocker is reached.
